title: Outschool welcomes Christopher Cirillo as Chief Product Officer
body_markdown:
We're excited to welcome Christopher Cirillo as Outschool's Chief Product Officer. Chris will lead our product strategy and team as we continue building more personalized, accessible learning experiences for kids and families around the world.


Chris brings more than 17 years of experience in education technology. Most recently, he served as Group Vice President of Product Management at PowerSchool, where he led teams responsible for learning management, assessment, and curriculum products. Previously, he spent eight years at Performance Matters, helping grow its K-12 assessment and analytics platform through its acquisition by PowerSchool. Throughout his career, he's focused on building innovative products and teams that make education more effective and accessible.


Chris shares Outschool's belief that every child deserves an education that fits their unique interests, needs, and goals. With thousands of live, interactive classes taught by expert teachers, Outschool gives families the flexibility to create learning experiences that work for them. Chris's focus is on making sure that choice turns into the right fit. He'll help make it easier for families to discover the right classes, connect with great teachers, and build personalized learning paths that help their kids thrive.


Known for his collaborative leadership and customer-first approach, Chris will work closely with Outschool's leadership, engineering, and design teams to shape the next chapter of our product experience.


We're thrilled to welcome Chris to Outschool!
